source_derived_contract.stress_mapping: stress_first_piola[q,i,J] has spatial vector row i and reference derivative column J; never symmetrize P or exchange off-diagonal entries.
source_derived_contract.element_force: Original r[a,i] = sum_q weights[q] * sum_J P_pair[q,i,J] * grad[q,a,J], retaining DD products and fixed-order reductions, rounded once by dd_value at output boundary.
source_derived_contract.flattened_order: element_material_force[cell,2*a+i], local a=(BL,BR,TR,TL), i=(x,y); use local nodes2/3 for body bottom support. Force ON body is negative local internal force.
source_derived_contract.quadrature: Nine-point tensor Simpson at xi/eta {-1,0,+1}; xi slow and eta fast, indices0..8. Original q1_operators: weights=outer([1,4,1],[1,4,1]).ravel() * hx*hy*thickness/36.
source_derived_contract.volume_units: Saved model weights already include area Jacobian and thickness20mm. Thickness comes from bound modelJSON material.thickness_mm, not an additional NPZ field. P is MPa=N/mm^2. Do not multiply volume contraction by thickness again.
source_derived_contract.edge_units: Existing top-edge ON-body trace P @ [0,-1] uses L/6*[1,4,1] * thickness once; top indices2/5/8. Edge trace is independent of volume weights.
source_derived_contract.identity: Bind raw model/result/two state descriptors, raw three selected archives, selected-field dtype/shape/C-order byte SHA, and copied old cell/occurrence/edge identities. state_sha equals assembler_state_sha; original target index, leg and d exact. Unused split-state SHA is provenance, not a new field read or reconstructed-state check.
source_derived_contract.selected_geometry: Cell10406 node IDs10467/10468/10637/10636 and cell10407 IDs10468/10469/10638/10637. Both use local2=TR/local3=TL on body bottom y31. source_derived_contract.material_weak_vs_edge: Compare and report descriptive discrepancy; do not impose weak-volume equals top-edge line gate and do not claim total Hu traction, pressure, effective grip or new equilibrium qualification.
source_derived_contract.saved_P_rounding: No P_hi/P_lo are saved in these force archives. A calculation from saved P is explicitly rounded-P reconstruction; it cannot be called exact original compensated replay. Preserve saved element material force as authoritative and report reconstruction minus saved force separately.
source_derived_contract.original_pair_replay_if_requested_later: Would require new permission and a new constitutive evaluation from saved lift/fluctuation, original grad/hessian/weights/points, lam/mu/kr and element DOF mapping; the current saved-P-only diagnostic avoids it.
